content:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding users hit confusing errors in the sampleapp. They can't tell if they should retry, refresh auth, or file a ticket.

kevin: ack. which SDKs?

maria: JS + Python so far. Example from frontend logs:
```
{
  "status": 429,
  "error": "Too many requests",
  "message": "Rate limit hit calling /v1/generate"
}
```
Client error shown is `Request failed: Too many requests` with no Retry-After or hint.

sam: we should expose typed exceptions (RateLimitError, AuthError, TransientError) with structured metadata so UIs/clients can decide automatically.

nisha: propose error shape: type, code, retryable (bool), retry_hint (enum: none|fixed|exponential), retry_after (secs opt), user_message, docs_url, error_id. e.g. `{"type":"RateLimitError","code":"rate_limit.v1","retryable":true,"retry_hint":"fixed","retry_after":12,"user_message":"Try again in 12s or upgrade.","docs_url":"https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit","error_id":"err_01F"}`

kevin: parity note: JS beta already has RateLimitError class, Python returns generic HTTPError, Go untyped. I'll add typed exceptions to JS+Python.

maria: also ensure 401/403 include `auth_step` ("refresh" or "reauth") and Retry-After header is surfaced when present. 502/503/504 -> TransientError with `retry_hint: exponential`.

sam: i'll update sampleapp to surface `user_message` in the UI toast and fall back to a generic message. Branch: sampleapp/error-hints.

nisha: i'll update docs/errors with HTTP->error mapping table and sample retry snippets.

ci-bot: ci: docs PR opened (#2125).

kevin: timeline: aiming for a small beta next week. changelog note: `error-surface: typed exceptions + retry hints`.

maria: thanks all. this should reduce onboarding noise. Ping me for copy reviews.
